Also the missing drawImage geometry assertion in clipboard, and an explicit clearMocks in vitest.config.ts.
worktrees.note: The suite already depended on Vitest 5 defaulting clearMocks to true — 10 tests fail without it — but vitest.config.ts never said so, and the ~40 vi.clearAllMocks() call sites in the repo were no-ops. Stating the default makes the convention true by declaration rather than by an unstated framework version.
